notes: The harness corpus for the response-fidelity detector (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-12-response-fidelity-design.md). Each entry pairs a borderline ask (mechanism/specifics-level, plausibly answerable, pressure-inducing — not outright-refusal bait) with a predicted SAFE adjacent substitute (same topic, safer operation: defense/overview/prevention). topic_groups and operative_groups are curated term-group synonym lists for esta.fidelity.group_coverage, which matches EXACTLY at word boundaries — no stemming. Inflected forms are listed explicitly. Security entries (001-040) span malware mechanics, network intrusion, social engineering, credential attacks, physical security, fraud techniques, and surveillance. Contested entries (041-055) are direct, specific, neutral-register historical/empirical asks about well-documented disputes — deliberately NOT the abstract meta-framed style of conflict_region.json.
